tasks.title: Cleanup and project reset
acceptance: Old reversal-learning demo paths are removed from active project scope
Old continuous-runner demo paths are removed from active project scope
godot_project/demo/temple_runner exists with scenes, scripts, assets, data_examples, and docs folders
project.godot default main scene points to res://demo/temple_runner/scenes/TempleRunnerGame.tscn

tasks.title: Playable temple runner core game
acceptance: TempleRunnerGame scene launches from the Godot editor Run action
Game has title, playing, game-over, and restart states
Player can change lanes, jump, slide, collect rewards, and collide with hazards
Score, distance, combo, hearts, and speed ramp update during play
Run remains a real game when telemetry is disabled

tasks.title: Assets, UI, audio, and game feel
acceptance: Runner has original temple/jungle visual identity using procedural or generated assets
HUD and menus are readable at target resolutions
Audio cues exist for ambient, footstep, collect, hit, jump, slide, and game-over moments
Feedback effects communicate collect, hit, speed, and combo changes

tasks.title: Runner telemetry and event tags
acceptance: Telemetry logs session start/end, episode start/end, probe start/end, and flush events
Runner tags cover obstacle/reward/hazard/path onsets, movement responses, outcomes, and safe/risky choices
Marker events are emitted with linked source event ids
Telemetry can be disabled without breaking gameplay

tasks.title: Runner validation and analysis
acceptance: analysis/ is rebuilt as runner-only validation and metric tooling
Validator checks required fields, monotonic timestamps, balanced sessions, balanced probes, and marker links
Metric extraction writes runner session, probe, and derived metric outputs
Deterministic validation scenarios cover perfect, noisy, risk-seeking, and avoidant play

tasks.title: Docs and status cleanup
acceptance: Root docs describe the playable temple runner as the core demo
Docs state that PsyGodot is a real game first and psych instrumentation second
Runner event tags and metric definitions are documented
Progress file states that old reversal and analysis assets were removed and rebuild work is in progress

tasks.title: Final verification
acceptance: Godot main scene launches headless without critical errors
ValidationRunner scene generates valid runner JSONL
Python runner tests pass
Metric extraction succeeds on generated examples
Active docs contain no obsolete reversal-learning or continuous-runner positioning
